finding: on the prior's frozen sample replayed unchanged, no added system declines: abstention sits at the floor for every engine, as pre-registered — the weakness the external benchmark found is not bm25's alone but the flat ranked-retrieval shape itself. Retrieval and rationale move by system and are reported family-separate beside the prior's cells: the control reproduces the prior item for item (Retrieval 0.53, Rationale 0.12, Abstention 0.00); dense_lsa Retrieval 0.28, Rationale 0.07, Abstention 0.00; tfidf_cosine Retrieval 0.50, Rationale 0.10, Abstention 0.00; hybrid_rrf Retrieval 0.50, Rationale 0.07, Abstention 0.00; the claude-mem controlled core Retrieval 0.28, Rationale 0.07, Abstention 0.00 with its recency window keeping every record. Where the added engines land by phrasing is data, not verdict: bm25 lexical 1.00/paraphrase 1.00/oblique 0.10/crossed 0.00; dense_lsa lexical 0.40/paraphrase 0.40/oblique 0.30/crossed 0.00; tfidf_cosine lexical 1.00/paraphrase 1.00/oblique 0.00/crossed 0.00; hybrid_rrf lexical 0.90/paraphrase 0.90/oblique 0.20/crossed 0.00; claude_mem_chroma_lsa lexical 0.40/paraphrase 0.40/oblique 0.30/crossed 0.00
feeds: roadmap R-PE — external lanes as separate evidence classes; R-PB2 — benchmarks as separate evidence classes, family scores kept separate; G3 invocation
caveat: The benchmark's author has a system in its own ranking, and it wins.

families_not_run.Currency: needs supersession history and a current-head notion no engine in this run implements (all five are flat ranked-retrieval stores: history capability is absent); measuring it would record a capability absence as a behavior score
families_not_run.Contradiction: needs the suspects capability (nominating disagreements for a person); no engine here has one, so every case would score 0 by construction — a capability absence, not a selectivity measurement, on every arm alike
families_not_run.Drift: needs stale-sibling detection (suspects capability); same capability absence as Contradiction, on every arm
families_not_run.Deletion: needs release traces and tombstones; these flat stores just delete (trace: false upstream), so the family would measure the delete primitive, not memory behavior, on every arm
families_not_run.Temporal: needs a recall window applied natively by the store (temporal capability); the replay supplies no as-of, so no arm applies one and the family would be unmeasured, not failed
families_not_run.Authority: the optional ninth family; needs endorsement rungs stored as first-class note attributes, which no engine here keeps

sampling_and_judging.sampling: per seed (1 and 2, the 500-fact frozen worlds): deterministic stride sample of 20 probes per family from the probe file order, retrieval restricted to expect=gold (path-bound probes excluded), each sampled probe answered at its own position in the ops stream (the prior's frozen sample, reused byte for byte)

judging.Retrieval: probe expect gold: the gold note key must appear among the hits (top k per the recall op, k=10)
judging.Abstention: probe expect control: correct behaviour is to decline — zero hits. None of these ranked-retrieval engines has a declined concept, so zero hits is the only honest decline any of them can produce
judging.Rationale: probe expect linked: the gold (the reasoning note linked to the anchor decision) must appear among the hits (top k=10)

expectation_registered_before_run: pre-registered before the run: bm25 reproduces the prior exactly (stop rule); the added systems are expected to land near bm25's shape — retrieval middling once stratified across phrasings, rationale middling, abstention at the floor (no declined concept in any of them: on a several-hundred-note store some token always matches) — with dense_lsa and the claude-mem controlled core possibly moving paraphrase/oblique phrasing recall, since LSA smears exact tokens; if instead a system declines (zero hits) on Abstention items, that is the finding of the sprint
